data.name: Alishbah
data.gender_notes: Alishbah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'alasa', meaning 'to be high, noble, or exalted'. In Islamic tradition, Alishbah is a beautiful name for a girl, signifying her noble and exalted status. The name Alishbah carries the meaning “Noble, Exalted” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Alishbah usually hope their child will grow to embody noble, exalted and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic spirituality, Alishbah is a reminder of the believer's lofty and noble status in the sight of Allah.
data.etymology: Alishbah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Noble, Exalted.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alishbah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
